scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n ai,api,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run ai" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
